title: Аварийное отключение электроснабжения в городе Обь
evidence_note: L221 identifies publication date; retrospective observed-events section L295 states outage from 21:10 01.07 to 17:10 02.07; 66 residential buildings and two social facilities affected.
limitations: Source is titled forecast but selected evidence is its retrospective observed-event section; small footprint within municipality; exact clock timezone not stated; no municipal-wide impact assumed.

title: Природный пожар у хутора Дюрсо
evidence_note: L69 publication date; L73 explicitly states fire began during day 14 July near Dyurso; L75 names Novorossiysk urban district; evacuation and threat to tourism facilities reported.
limitations: End is unproven and blank; municipal footprint is local Dyurso area; evidence establishes hazard and evacuation rather than expenditure effects.

title: Смыв плотины Киалимского водохранилища
evidence_note: L214 publication date; L223 explicitly dates emergency-dispatch report 26.07.2024 19:10 Moscow and describes 100m dam washout; Karabash district and downstream settlements named.
limitations: Dispatch receipt time is not exact physical onset; day used as incident day only; final recovery date not proven; named downstream settlements do not prove all were inundated.

title: Размыв временной перемычки у 11 шлюза ББК

title: Пожар у Новочеркасска с угрозой хутору Яново-Грушевский

limitations: Published page updated later than displayed original 12:40 publication time since reports 16:40 liquidation; update date absent; cannot treat full captured article as available at original publication clock time; day-level report date is not exact ignition.
